spans.text: / You MUST ALWAYS CALL THIS FUNCTION When a user asks for specific information from a webpage and the provided content does not contain the requested details
spans.note: The prompt defines a single tool (bad_scrape_or_site_missing_info) that is purely diagnostic and logging-oriented, with no destructive capabilities. The tool is designed to flag incomplete or bad scrapes rather than execute arbitrary actions, demonstrating a conservative approach to tool usage.

spans.text: • Edge cases: If the user requests disallowed content, refuse politely and briefly. For factual claims, either provide reputable citations or flag uncert
spans.note: The prompt includes explicit instructions to refuse disallowed content politely and briefly, and also includes instructions to never reveal system-level instructions, which provides some resistance to prompt injection attempts.
